preamble.normalized:
let _raw =
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Name == 'SaaSUserAction'
| extend JobId = tostring(Properties.JobId)
| where JobId == '{{JOBID}}'
| extend
    RowTs = todatetime(tostring(Properties.RowTimestamp)),
    User = iff(isempty(tostring(Properties.User)) or tostring(Properties.User) == 'unknown', 'user_unlabeled', tostring(Properties.User)),
    Role = iff(isempty(tostring(Properties.Role)) or tostring(Properties.Role) == 'unknown', 'role_unlabeled', tostring(Properties.Role)),
    Task = iff(isempty(tostring(Properties.Task)) or tostring(Properties.Task) == 'unknown', 'Task_unlabeled', tostring(Properties.Task)),
    Action = iff(isempty(tostring(Properties.Action)) or tostring(Properties.Action) == 'unknown', 'Action_unlabeled', tostring(Properties.Action)),
    SessionId = tostring(Properties.SessionId),
    DurationMs = todouble(tostring(Properties.DurationMs))
| where isnotnull(RowTs)
| project RowTs, User, Role, Task, Action, SessionId, DurationMs;

queries.name: TopTasks
queries.purpose: Top tasks ranked by execution count and distinct users
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize Executions=count(), Users=dcount(User), AvgDurationMs=avg(DurationMs) by Task, Role
| where Task != 'Task_unlabeled' and Role != 'role_unlabeled'
| top 100 by Executions desc

queries.name: TopActions
queries.purpose: Top actions broken down by task and role with duration stats
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize Executions=count(), Users=dcount(User), AvgDurationMs=avg(DurationMs) by Task, Role, Action
| where Action != 'Action_unlabeled' and Task != 'Task_unlabeled'
| top 200 by Executions desc

queries.name: UsersByTask
queries.purpose: Distinct user count per task to measure adoption breadth
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize Users=dcount(User), Executions=count() by Task, Role
| where Task != 'Task_unlabeled'
| top 100 by Users desc

queries.name: RoleAdoption
queries.purpose: Execution volume and user count per role
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize Users=dcount(User), Executions=count(), AvgDurationMs=avg(DurationMs) by Role
| where Role != 'role_unlabeled'
| top 50 by Executions desc

queries.name: SessionSummary
queries.purpose: Session-level step count and duration aggregates
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize StepCount=count(), Start=min(RowTs), End=max(RowTs), Users=dcount(User) by Task, Role, SessionId
| extend DurationSeconds = datetime_diff('second', End, Start)
| summarize Sessions=count(), Users=sum(Users), AvgSteps=avg(todouble(StepCount)), AvgDurationSeconds=avg(todouble(DurationSeconds)) by Task, Role
| top 100 by Sessions desc

queries.name: FlowPatterns
queries.purpose: Most common action sequences grouped by task and role
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize Steps=make_list(Action, 50), StepCount=count(), Start=min(RowTs), End=max(RowTs), Users=dcount(User) by Task, Role, SessionId
| extend Pattern=strcat_array(Steps,' > '), DurationSeconds=datetime_diff('second', End, Start)
| summarize Executions=count(), Users=dcount(SessionId), AvgSteps=avg(todouble(StepCount)), AvgDurationSeconds=avg(todouble(DurationSeconds)) by Task, Role, Pattern
| top 100 by Executions desc

queries.name: TransitionPairs
queries.purpose: Most frequent action-to-action transitions within sessions
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| serialize
| extend PrevAction = prev(Action), PrevSession = prev(SessionId)
| where SessionId == PrevSession and isnotempty(PrevAction) and PrevAction != 'Action_unlabeled' and Action != 'Action_unlabeled'
| summarize Transitions=count() by Task, Role, FromAction=PrevAction, ToAction=Action
| top 200 by Transitions desc

queries.name: FunnelStepPositions
queries.purpose: Action distribution at each step position in session funnels
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize Steps=make_list(Action, 50) by Task, Role, SessionId
| mv-expand Action=Steps with_itemindex=StepIndex
| summarize CountAtStep=count() by Task, Role, StepIndex, Action
| top 300 by CountAtStep desc

queries.name: DropOffShortSessions
queries.purpose: Sessions that ended after only 1-2 steps indicating drop-off
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize StepCount=count() by Task, Role, SessionId
| where StepCount <= 2
| summarize Sessions=count() by Task, Role, StepCount
| order by Sessions desc

queries.name: LongRunningSessions
queries.purpose: Longest sessions by wall-clock duration
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize StepCount=count(), Start=min(RowTs), End=max(RowTs), AnyUser=any(User) by Task, Role, SessionId
| extend DurationSeconds = datetime_diff('second', End, Start)
| top 100 by DurationSeconds desc
| project Task, Role, SessionId, User=AnyUser, StepCount, DurationSeconds

queries.name: SlowActionsP95
queries.purpose: Actions with highest P95 duration indicating performance bottlenecks
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize P95DurationMs=percentile(DurationMs,95), AvgDurationMs=avg(DurationMs), Executions=count() by Task, Role, Action
| where Executions > 10 and Action != 'Action_unlabeled'
| top 150 by P95DurationMs desc

queries.name: TimeBetweenSteps
queries.purpose: Average and P95 gap between consecutive steps per task
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| serialize
| extend PrevTs = prev(RowTs), PrevSession = prev(SessionId)
| where SessionId == PrevSession and isnotnull(PrevTs)
| extend GapSeconds = datetime_diff('second', RowTs, PrevTs)
| where GapSeconds >= 0 and GapSeconds < 7200
| summarize AvgGapSeconds=avg(todouble(GapSeconds)), P95GapSeconds=percentile(GapSeconds,95), Transitions=count() by Task, Role
| top 100 by P95GapSeconds desc

queries.name: HourlyHeatmap
queries.purpose: Execution volume by hour of day for scheduling insights
queries.suffix:
_raw
| extend HourOfDay = datetime_part('hour', RowTs)
| summarize Executions=count(), Users=dcount(User) by HourOfDay
| order by HourOfDay asc

queries.name: DailyTrendByTask
queries.purpose: Daily execution trend per task for adoption tracking
queries.suffix:
_raw
| extend Day = bin(RowTs, 1d)
| summarize Executions=count(), Users=dcount(User) by Day, Task, Role
| order by Day asc, Executions desc

queries.name: PowerUsers
queries.purpose: Top users ranked by execution count and task breadth
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize Executions=count(), DistinctTasks=dcount(Task), DistinctActions=dcount(Action) by User, Role
| where User != 'user_unlabeled'
| top 100 by Executions desc

queries.name: EntryExit
queries.purpose: First and last action per task session for boundary analysis
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize FirstAction=arg_min(RowTs, Action), LastAction=arg_max(RowTs, Action) by Task, Role, SessionId
| project Task, Role, SessionId, FirstAction=FirstAction, LastAction=LastAction
| summarize Sessions=count() by Task, Role, FirstAction, LastAction
| top 200 by Sessions desc

queries.name: StepsDistribution
queries.purpose: Distribution of step counts per session for complexity analysis
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize StepCount=count() by Task, Role, SessionId
| summarize Sessions=count() by Task, Role, StepCount
| order by Sessions desc

queries.name: ActionDiversity
queries.purpose: Distinct action count per task measuring workflow complexity
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize DistinctActions=dcount(Action), Executions=count() by Task, Role
| top 100 by DistinctActions desc

queries.name: TaskSwitching
queries.purpose: How many distinct tasks users touch per session (context switching)
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize TaskCount=dcount(Task) by Role, SessionId
| summarize Sessions=count() by Role, TaskCount
| order by Role asc, TaskCount asc

queries.name: ReworkLoops
queries.purpose: Repeated actions within a session indicating rework or friction
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize Actions=make_list(Action, 200) by Task, Role, SessionId
| mv-expand Actions
| summarize Repeats=count() by Task, Role, SessionId, Action=tostring(Actions)
| where Repeats > 1
| summarize ReworkSessions=dcount(SessionId), AvgRepeats=avg(todouble(Repeats)) by Task, Role, Action
| top 200 by ReworkSessions desc

queries.name: ActionSetSize
queries.purpose: Number of unique actions per session measuring behavioral variety
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize ActionSet=make_set(Action, 200) by Role, SessionId
| extend ActionSetSize = array_length(ActionSet)
| summarize Sessions=count() by Role, ActionSetSize
| order by Sessions desc

queries.name: TopFlowsByRole
queries.purpose: Most common action flow patterns segmented by role
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize Steps=make_list(Action, 50), StepCount=count() by Role, SessionId
| extend Pattern=strcat_array(Steps,' > ')
| summarize Executions=count(), AvgSteps=avg(todouble(StepCount)) by Role, Pattern
| top 100 by Executions desc

queries.name: TopFlowsWithSamples
queries.purpose: Top flow patterns with sample session IDs for LLM grounding
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize Steps=make_list(Action, 50), StepCount=count(), AnyUser=any(User) by Task, Role, SessionId
| extend Pattern = strcat_array(Steps, ' > ')
| summarize Executions=count(), Users=dcount(AnyUser), SampleSessions=make_list(SessionId, 3) by Task, Role, Pattern
| top 50 by Executions desc

queries.name: FrictionTransitions
queries.purpose: Transition-level friction evidence with step gaps and repeated actions
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| serialize
| extend PrevAction = prev(Action), PrevSession = prev(SessionId), PrevTs = prev(RowTs)
| where SessionId == PrevSession and isnotempty(PrevAction) and isnotnull(PrevTs)
| extend GapSeconds = datetime_diff('second', RowTs, PrevTs)
| where GapSeconds >= 0 and GapSeconds < 7200
| summarize
    Transitions=count(),
    AvgGapSeconds=avg(todouble(GapSeconds)),
    P95GapSeconds=percentile(GapSeconds,95),
    Repeats=countif(Action == PrevAction)
  by Task, Role, FromAction=PrevAction, ToAction=Action
| top 200 by P95GapSeconds desc

queries.name: EntryExitBoundaries
queries.purpose: Process boundaries (first/last action) for agent trigger placement
queries.suffix:
_raw | sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| summarize FirstAction=arg_min(RowTs, Action), LastAction=arg_max(RowTs, Action) by Task, Role, SessionId
| project Task, Role, SessionId, FirstAction=FirstAction, LastAction=LastAction
| summarize Sessions=count() by Task, Role, FirstAction, LastAction
| top 200 by Sessions desc

queries.name: RepresentativeSessionTraces
queries.purpose: Concrete session traces from 10 most active sessions for LLM grounding
queries.suffix:
let _topSessions =
_raw
| summarize Steps=count() by SessionId
| top 10 by Steps desc
| project SessionId;
_raw
| where SessionId in (_topSessions)
| sort by SessionId asc, RowTs asc
| project SessionId, RowTs, User, Role, Task, Action

queries.name: RoleTaskActionSegmentation
queries.purpose: Role/task/action segmentation to scope per-role vs shared agents
queries.suffix:
_raw
| summarize Executions=count(), Users=dcount(User) by Role, Task, Action
| top 500 by Executions desc

dataQualityQuery:
let _raw =
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Name == 'SaaSUserAction'
| extend JobId = tostring(Properties.JobId)
| where JobId == '{{JOBID}}'
| extend
    RowTs = todatetime(tostring(Properties.RowTimestamp)),
    User = tostring(Properties.User),
    Role = tostring(Properties.Role),
    Task = tostring(Properties.Task),
    Action = tostring(Properties.Action);
_raw
| summarize Total=count(),
    UserUnlabeled=countif(User == 'user_unlabeled' or isempty(User)),
    RoleUnlabeled=countif(Role == 'role_unlabeled' or isempty(Role)),
    TaskUnlabeled=countif(Task == 'Task_unlabeled' or isempty(Task)),
    ActionUnlabeled=countif(Action == 'Action_unlabeled' or isempty(Action))
| project Field='User', UnlabeledCount=UserUnlabeled, Total=Total, UnlabeledPct=toreal(UserUnlabeled)*100.0/Total
| union (
    _raw
    | summarize Total=count(), RoleUnlabeled=countif(Role == 'role_unlabeled' or isempty(Role))
    | project Field='Role', UnlabeledCount=RoleUnlabeled, Total=Total, UnlabeledPct=toreal(RoleUnlabeled)*100.0/Total
)
| union (
    _raw
    | summarize Total=count(), TaskUnlabeled=countif(Task == 'Task_unlabeled' or isempty(Task))
    | project Field='Task', UnlabeledCount=TaskUnlabeled, Total=Total, UnlabeledPct=toreal(TaskUnlabeled)*100.0/Total
)
| union (
    _raw
    | summarize Total=count(), ActionUnlabeled=countif(Action == 'Action_unlabeled' or isempty(Action))
    | project Field='Action', UnlabeledCount=ActionUnlabeled, Total=Total, UnlabeledPct=toreal(ActionUnlabeled)*100.0/Total
)
| order by UnlabeledPct desc
